title: Hygeia, a City of Health
author: Benjamin Ward Richardson

authorInfo.bio: Benjamin Ward Richardson (1828–1896) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Hygeia, a City of Health" by Benjamin Ward Richardson is a scientific publication likely written in the late 19th century. This work serves as a theoretical framework proposing the design of an ideal city focused on public health and sanitation.
